I can confirm that the final `TMP` equals the final `e`: the last three assignments swap `d` and `e`, leaving `TMP` holding the final value of `e`. I can’t reliably determine all the numeric values without executing the full sequence.

This Python script will evaluate the assignments if you paste the question into its input:

```python
import re
import sys

values = {}
text = sys.stdin.read()
for name, source in re.findall(
    r'\b([a-h]|TMP)\s*<-\s*(\d+|[a-h]|TMP)\b', text
):
    values[name] = int(source) if source.isdigit() else values[source]

print("ANSWER: " + " ".join(
    f"{name} ?= {values[name]};"
    for name in "abcdefgh"
) + f" TMP ?= {values['TMP']};")
```
